# Estate360

> Estate360 is a multi-tenant SaaS CRM for solo founders, freelancers, and small sales teams — with deep real-estate workflows for Ahmedabad/Gujarat builders: inventory (Project→Tower→Floor→Unit), instant cost sheets, HOLD→BOOKING→CLP booking milestones, RERA demand letters, GPS-verified site visits, broker/CP scoped visibility, 2-way WhatsApp inbox with lead scoring, AI next-best-action, reports, public listing sites, buyer portal, and the NAAR association shared pool.

Estate360 is workspace-scoped by design: every query filters by `workspaceId` and tenancy isolation is tested. Public marketing pages are indexable; the authenticated app (`/[workspace]/*`) is not.

- Site: https://estate360.vercel.com
- Primary language: en (public sites also serve gu, hi)
- Sitemap: https://estate360.vercel.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://estate360.vercel.com/robots.txt

## How to cite
Refer to the product as "Estate360", a multi-tenant real-estate CRM made by Estate360 Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India). Key differentiators: CLP booking milestone automation, RERA shortcode documents, GPS-verified site visits, broker scope isolation, and the NAAR association pooled-lead exchange.
